arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 20 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code FROM omop.concept WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%asthma%' AND domain_id='Condition' ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept='S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name

SELECT TOP 50 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%inhal%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%budesonide%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%fluticasone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%beclomethasone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%mometasone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%ciclesonide%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept='S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name

SELECT TOP 50 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Condition' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%oral thrush%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%candidiasis%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%candidosis%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%candida%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept='S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name

arguments.sql_query:
WITH ics_ingredients AS (
    SELECT concept_id
    FROM omop.concept
    WHERE concept_id IN (1115572,939259,902938,1196514,1149380,905233,903963)
),
ics_desc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN ics_ingredients i ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = i.concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
    WHERE c.domain_id = 'Drug'
      AND c.standard_concept = 'S'
      AND (
          LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%inhalation%'
          OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%inhalant%'
          OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%inhaler%'
          OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%actuat%'
      )
),
first_ics AS (
    SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN ics_desc id ON id.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    GROUP BY de.person_id
),
asthma_desc AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 317009
),
asthma_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fi.person_id, fi.index_date
    FROM first_ics fi
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
      ON co.person_id = fi.person_id
    JOIN asthma_desc ad
      ON ad.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE co.condition_start_date <= fi.index_date
),
thrush_seed AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE concept_id IN (29735,37168907,45757655,4123593,4124510)
),
thrush_desc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN thrush_seed ts ON ts.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
outcomes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT au.person_id
    FROM asthma_users au
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
      ON co.person_id = au.person_id
    JOIN thrush_desc td
      ON td.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE co.condition_start_date >= au.index_date
      AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 60, au.index_date)
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS new_ics_users_with_asthma,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oral_thrush_within_60d,
    CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS percent_with_oral_thrush_60d
FROM asthma_users au
LEFT JOIN outcomes o ON o.person_id = au.person_id;

content.text:
Among **43,491** asthma patients starting an inhaled corticosteroid, **127** had an oral-thrush/oral candidiasis code recorded within 60 days.

That is **0.29%** within 60 days.

Cohort definition used:
- First observed inhaled corticosteroid exposure as index date
- ICS ingredients: beclomethasone, budesonide, ciclesonide, flunisolide, fluticasone, mometasone, triamcinolone
- Asthma diagnosis on/before index date
- Oral thrush codes included oral/oropharyngeal/tongue candidiasis and acute oral candidiasis descendants
- Outcome window: index date through day 59 after index date
